Future<void> run(groups, other, read, output) async {
  for (final batch in groups) {
    // A synchronous prelude does not await.
    report(batch.length);
    // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
    final rows = await Future.wait<Row>(
      batch.where((item) => item.enabled).map(read),
      eagerError: true,
    );
    output.addAll(rows);
  }
  for (final batch in groups) {
    if (batch.isNotEmpty)
      output.addAll(
        // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
        await Future.wait(batch.where((item) => item.enabled).map(read)),
      );
  }
  for (final batch in groups) {
    // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
    final rows = await batch
        .where((item) => item.enabled)
        .map<Future<Row>>(read)
        .wait;
  }
  for (final batch in groups) {
    // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
    await Future.wait(
      batch
          .where((item) => item.enabled && item.readyForAnotherAttempt)
          .map(
            (item) => read(
              item,
              'a long collection argument that the formatter wraps',
            ),
          ),
      eagerError: true,
      cleanUp: clean,
    );
  }
  for (final batch in groups) {
    // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
    final rows = await Future.wait(
      other.where((item) => item.enabled).map(read),
    );
  }
  for (final item in other) {
    // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
    final rows = await Future.wait([read(item), notify(item)]);
  }
  for (final batch in groups) {
    // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
    await reportAsync(batch);
    // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
    final rows = await Future.wait(
      batch.where((item) => item.enabled).map(read),
    );
  }
}

Future<dynamic> first(groups, read) async {
  for (final batch in groups)
    return await Future.wait(batch.where((item) => item.enabled).map(read));
}
